embedding_boundary.rviz: external_native_window_or_low_latency_stream_adapter; frontend does not own robotics truth
embedding_boundary.unreal: external_native_window_or_render_stream_adapter; frontend does not own physics or controller truth
embedding_boundary.qgc: project-owned QGroundControl custom build; upstream vendor source remains immutable and all MoSim actions go through the Orchestrator

safety_rules: UI labels come from registry and profile metadata, not hard-coded controller lists
non-selectable modules remain visible only in research/status views
start_run is forbidden until profile validation returns accepted=true
all injection controls display requested and applied values separately
blocked and failed states preserve reason_code and evidence links
claim_boundary: This handoff freezes the frontend-facing contract only. It is not a frontend implementation or runtime acceptance result.
